title: PLAYER 2 SCREEN CLEAR CLEARS THE SCREEN
why: In co-op, the SCREEN CLEAR power-up player 2 picked up killed nothing. His window sent each machine to the host as a 9999 damage shot, the host throws away any shot over 1500 as bad, so every machine kept its health; he also got no SCREEN CLEAR medal, and the dead shots still charged his air strike meter. Proven in headless Chromium: his pulse on 3 crawlers sent 3 shots of 9999, the host answered bad to each and all 3 kept full health, medal paid 0 times. Now his window sends the host a screen clear word per machine, the host clears each exactly as its own screen clear does (credited to nobody, no streak, no kill), his window pays the medal, and the air strike meter is left alone as for player 1.
now: Player 2's SCREEN CLEAR now wipes the machines on his screen and pays his medal, like player 1.
